notes.title: Devlog/Newsletter/Blog-Post/Thing - 01
notes.content:
[p]Oh, hello,
[/p][p]Welcome to a [b]Newsletter/Devlog/Blog-Post/Thing! 
[/b][/p][p]We wanted to do some more long form updates, to let people know what we were doing, making, and thinking about, both in terms of Key Fairy, and [i]beyond![/i] [/p][p][/p][p]So what [i]have[/i] we been up to for the past couple o’ months?[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/ea1a746c97732acefd1d01ea9ac78008d175117a.gif"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2][b]Key Fairy Development![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We've been expanding the forest, with more [b]Ecosystems[/b]! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Keep[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]They wander northward in fallow light, as statues loom, and soft soil is smothered by the creeping paves of [b]THE KEEP[/b]![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/cd7e4db1b45d4ed577096f02bb1de5d4a330b15f.png"][/img][/p][p]Where the earlier parts of the forest are filled with wild [i]beasts[/i], the Keep is dark, dour and quiet. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/53f2403b3fd09354450d139f36304fe7d3cd54d5.png"][/img][/p][p]Paved, dark, and littered with traps, our hero is ascending further towards the [b]\[REDACTED][/b] smothering the forest.
[/p][h3][b]The “Creatures”[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]As they dance through this solemn land, the fairy's footfalls scatter the “creatures”. [/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Crows litter the Keep, scavenging for what trinkets they can find, and bringing them back to their secretive covens [i](crowvens?)[/i]. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/51802f88e51e1d342219be4c817505757c632f2d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Even these birds are not immune to what consumes the forest, with some crows known to assemble into a hostile cloaked form.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/81115d385647908e44b641ef98a69b8f39fc3c9c.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Water[/b][/h3][p]
[i]Oh but alas, though quick on their feet on soil or stone, our poor fairy is easily whisked away by the rushing river that courses strangely through the forest.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/171e43fbc4e54eb6a0d7d9793527fb8c2758ac7b.gif"][/img][/p][p]We have been trying to make the water work for [i]one-hundred years[/i]. But now it sort of does![/p][p][/p][p]Water is[b] hard[/b] in our stark black-and-white art style, but we got it to work using dithering, combined with  particles to produce foam and a scrolling texture effect that follows a [b]spline[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/96858ce7f97f0b90ec30af410ddc1d0ce10ab20a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The water is important as a [b]metroidvania[/b] element, blocking progress until you find a way to cross it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/e16dfe47e514fee8e01f1bf9991dc9278c9c461c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What else have we been up to?[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Tex?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]I (Tex?) got lost in the sauce experimenting on a cozy sheep herding game![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/6a4ff1cc10f8f959ae63456c29a1000f90c204c0.png"][/img][/p][p]I ultimately decided to bench this prototype, and I talk about why in [url="https://neighbourhoodsnake.com/2025/08/25/on-destruction/"][u]this blog post[/u][/url]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Niosis?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]I (Niosis?) have been learning about poetry and playing copious amounts of [url="https://chrismcdee.itch.io/mythic-bastionland"]Mythic Bastionland[/url], a TTRPG about strange arthurian knights seeking out myths. Here is Carrowmoor, land of bogs and other more interesting things.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/25ae48b828c8713e7ce9f1046aca709875305c6e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I haven’t been up to much personal art this month, but [b]maidens[/b] with swords and [b]dungeons[/b] full of ghouls are never far from my heart.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/acace8f66896231174932e102c0aa82a48f7b8b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/c76db285eb8e0a50db22234099ae3a9e6768e26f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Announcements und’ Events![/b] [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/ba451f722117c55f1d56c02aa1e89e3b0a41087c.gif"][/img][/p][p]We are preparing for a series of back to back events from the [b]1st[/b] of [b]October[/b] to the [b]20th[/b]![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Melbourne International Games Week Steam Festival (October 1-10)[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]We'll be in Melbourne, for international games week, and we'll have a demo on Steam, for [b]international eyes[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]We are also going to be delivering two (2) talks in Melbourne! We will be talking at [url="https://www.freakon.com.au/"]Freakon[/url] on the 6th, and at [url="https://www.freeplay.net.au/parallels25"]Freeplay Parallels[/url] on the 9th! If you are gonna be at either of those events... cool![/p][p][/p][h3][b]PAX Aus (October 10-12)[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]We'll be in [b]Melbourne[/b], showcasing at [b]PAX[/b]! Come say hi! (If you can't make it to Melbourne there will also be a [b]steam event[/b]!)[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Next Fest[/b] [b](October 13-20) [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ll have a demo as part of Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p][i]How different will this demo be from the last one you ask?... We'll have to see! It will definitely be more polished, but we don't want to spend too much time making unique demos instead of developing the full game![/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/c664d76f277e25779317e4c075b24c9b800bda66.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Oke, goodbye now![/h2][p][/p][p]If people like this we will try and make it semi-regular! To [b]stay up to date[/b] with what we are making ([i]both in terms of Key Fairy and beyond[/i]) you can [b]hit the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878580/Key_Fairy/"]Follow Button on Steam[/url],[/b] or [b]join our [url="https://discord.gg/VE5c3sbAfC" buttoncolor="#fb3741"]Discord[/url]![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/d7a4cd2ff099ef6191a1f3bf3e84a5777558bf4d.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you have a lovely week, that you may sleep well in the moonlight, and prance gaily through the days![/p][p]
[/p][p]Lots of Love,[/p][p]Owl Machine[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Key Fairy Demo is Out!
notes.content: [p]As part of [b]Frosty Games Fest[/b] we have launched our [b]First Public Demo for Key Fairy[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Now is your chance to dance through the woodland, swap tales with strange folk, and evade forgotten gods![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/e2a92a7e877c5db7d038013fc0c366ca84e60f8b.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it! and if you have any feedback or issues, let us know in the [b]Discussion Page[/b] or on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FGGdesxTThn"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067359/fbeb7af5a47fc182db9e05a1a76954f56ab8f976.png"][/img][/p]
